name: SAP ICM2SHELL
tile_line: If SAP's web ports are reachable. No attacks yet.
tldr: A WebSocket bug in SAP's web server (ICM and Web Dispatcher) lets an attacker with no login leak memory or run code as the SAP admin user. SAP rates it 10.0; exploits exist but aren't public, no attacks. If its web ports are reachable, patch.
summary: It hits the ICM in NetWeaver AS ABAP and every SAP Web Dispatcher, including the one in HANA XS, and WebSocket support is on by default. SAP fixed it on 10 Nov 2026. Onapsis named it "ICM2SHELL" and nullFaktor "SAPBleed"; the SAP admin user is `<sid>adm`.

affected.label: Kernel or Web Dispatcher not patched
affected.text: AS ABAP on kernel 7.40 or newer (7.22 isn't affected) and every Web Dispatcher. Fixed in 7.53 PL 1616, 7.54 PL 710, 7.77 PL 914, 7.93 PL 420 (or the updated-stack PL 401; PL 419 is still affected), 9.16 PL 111, 9.18 PL 37 and 9.20 PL 11. HANA 2.0 Web Dispatcher: 2.00.079.11 or 2.00.089.05; XS Advanced 1.0 SP05: Patch 4. Out-of-maintenance kernels (7.40, 7.41, 7.42, 7.45, 7.49, 7.73, 7.81, 7.85, 7.89) get no fix. AS Java alone isn't affected; dual-stack systems are. Check each server's kernel patch level in transaction SM51.

affected.label: WebSocket upgrades are on
affected.text: On by default in both the ICM and the Web Dispatcher, whether or not you use WebSockets. Not affected if `icm/HTTP/support_websocket_upgrade` is set to `FALSE`.

affected.label: Attackers can reach its web port
affected.text: Anyone who can reach the ICM or Web Dispatcher HTTP or HTTPS port can attack it; no SAP user or click is needed. An unpatched Web Dispatcher in front of the ICM doesn't stop the attack and can pass it on to internal systems.

do.label: Apply SAP Notes 3778530 and 3778556
do.text: Patch the kernel (ICM) and every Web Dispatcher, including HANA XS, to the fixed patch level for your release, then restart. On an out-of-maintenance kernel, move to a supported kernel first.

do.label: Can't patch? Turn off WebSocket
do.text: Set this parameter in the ICM and Web Dispatcher profiles and restart. It breaks ABAP Push Channels and some Fiori apps, so first look for status code 101 in the ICM or Web Dispatcher HTTP log. SAP's FAQ Note 3778788 says where the parameter goes for each component.

do.label: Or shield behind a patched Web Dispatcher
do.text: A Web Dispatcher on 7.53 PL 1629, 7.54 PL 723, 7.93 PL 430, 9.16 PL 200 or later protects systems behind it, but only if nothing can reach them directly (check with a network scan) and it isn't set up with `PROT=ROUTER`.

do.label: Keep SAP web ports off the internet
do.text: Until you've patched, limit who can reach the ICM and Web Dispatcher ports.
